purpose: Role B experiment and evaluation protocol; fixed before new test scoring.

selection.neural_method_comparison: Compare mean best-validation F1 across seeds 0, 1 and 2; deterministic classic baselines use their validation F1.
selection.checkpoint_within_run: Select the first epoch attaining the highest validation entity-level micro F1 among evaluated epochs.
selection.representative_checkpoint: Use seed 0 for a stochastic method; do not select the highest-scoring seed on validation or test.
selection.test: Only after model and experiment settings are fixed, evaluate each selected checkpoint once per predefined test condition. Do not tune using test metrics. Existing A/C results have already exposed test information and this limitation will be disclosed.

dev_hyperparameter_search.status: Prespecified before the additional candidate runs and before new held-out test scoring; the baseline validation scores were already observed.
dev_hyperparameter_search.selection_rule: For each model and domain compare the seed-0 candidates by best full-dev exact-entity micro F1; ties select the baseline. Then use seeds 0, 1 and 2 of the selected configuration for method comparison.
dev_hyperparameter_search.bilstm_crf: Compare baseline hidden=128, dropout=0.3, learning_rate=0.001 with hidden=96, dropout=0.5, learning_rate=0.0005; both train for at most 5 epochs with validation each epoch.
dev_hyperparameter_search.bert: Compare baseline learning_rate=0.00003, batch_size=8 with learning_rate=0.00002, batch_size=16; both train for at most 3 epochs with validation each epoch.
dev_hyperparameter_search.span: Compare baseline learning_rate=0.00003, batch_size=4 with learning_rate=0.00002, batch_size=2; both train for at most 3 epochs with validation each epoch.
dev_hyperparameter_search.interpretation: This compact search varies multiple parameters jointly; it does not estimate the independent effect of each parameter. Epoch count is selected through the best validation checkpoint, not an independent factorial search.
dev_hyperparameter_search.transfer: CoNLL and WNUT source transfers use their native-domain BERT winning learning rate, batch size, and seed-0 selected epoch count. They use the checkpoint at that fixed epoch rather than choosing again on the mapped validation set. For the merged source, compare the same two BERT configurations on concatenated source validation data before fixing its transfer model and epoch.
dev_hyperparameter_search.other_experiments: Previously specified learning-curve and distillation runs retain their fixed settings; their configurations and differences from the tuned domain models will be disclosed.

transfer.mapping: Use the team's transfer mapping before training, and project gold and predictions consistently for scoring.
transfer.merged_validation: Concatenate source validation splits; do not inspect target test scores for selection.

learning_curve.sampling: Use models.llm.common.sample_train and the team's fixed test-300 IDs.
learning_curve.historical_limitation: The CoNLL 20-epoch small-sample schedule was adopted after examining seed-0 validation. This is exploratory validation-driven tuning and will be disclosed. WNUT/MIT use this fixed schedule without consulting their test results.

span.decode: Argmax non-NONE labels and greedily resolve overlaps by descending class probability; ties are deterministic.
span.limitations: Flat nonoverlapping entities only; entities longer than the maximum cannot be predicted.

representation_ablation.architecture: A separate, fixed 798-dimensional BiLSTM-CRF is retrained for all four modes; do not mix it with the original 130-dimensional main M3 checkpoint.
representation_ablation.random_control: Random-initialized embeddings are frozen for this controlled comparison, and use the GloVe vocabulary and scale; this is not a conventional trainable-random-embedding baseline or a model free of pretrained-resource influence.
representation_ablation.glove_control: GloVe vectors are frozen; character features are used only in the glove_char mode. Frozen BERT uses first-subword features. Input feature dimensions differ in effective nonzero content, so differences are not attributed causally to a single factor.

statistics.comparison: Paired resampling of identical sentence IDs; report confidence intervals for F1 differences.
